Quake celebrates its 30th birthday on June 22, 2026. To mark the occasion, various jams will be held on the Mapping Discord server. One of these will focus entirely on deathmatch maps. The Filth Pit is my contribution to this event. 

The map's theme is sewage drainage. It features narrow, winding sewage canals that usually end in larger areas containing important items.

Currently, the map is still in secret beta and will be released as soon as it's ready.
